SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME , TARGET , KEY_1 , KEY_2 , KEY_3 FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE TARGET = 'KRDONG0647' AND DOC_NAME = 'ITEM_DOWN' AND KEY_10 = 'N' ORDER BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_3
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO ,UNIT_PRICE ,CHANGE_DATE AS QUOTA_FROM_DATE ,TO_DATE AS QUOTA_TO_DATE FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = 'KRDONG0647' AND CONTRACT_NO = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND CONTRACT_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND BUYER_ITEM_NO= '$G_RS.KEY_3$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'Y' , KEY_9 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME= '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.KEY_3$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E' , KEY_9 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME= '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.KEY_3$'
